Message.Name: Snapshot Request Message
Message.Description: The Snapshot Request message is sent from the client to the Deep Snap server to authenticate and request a Snapshot Response

Field.Name: Authentication Token
Field.Description: Token supplied by Iex Market Ops, left justified and space padded on the right

Field.Name: Channel Id
Field.Description: Channel identifier from the Deep feed IexTp header

Field.Name: Session Id
Field.Description: Session identifier from the Deep feed IexTp header

Field.Name: Minimum Sequence Number
Field.Description: Minimum sequence number useable by the client, zero returns the latest snapshot available

Message.Name: Error Response Message
Message.Description: Sent by the Deep Snap server to the client when a Snapshot Request is rejected

Field.Name: Reject Reason Code
Field.Description: Reason the Snapshot Request was rejected

Message.Name: Snapshot Start Message
Message.Description: First message of a Snapshot Response sent from the Deep Snap server when a Snapshot Request is successful

Field.Name: Snapshot Length
Field.Description: Length in bytes of the complete Snapshot Response including the Snapshot Start message, all Snapshot Data messages, and the Snapshot End message

Message.Name: Snapshot Data Message
Message.Description: Carries one complete Deep feed message wrapped with an IexTp header providing Deep feed sequencing and timing information

Field.Name: IexTp Header
Field.Description: IexTp header for the wrapped Deep feed message, see the Iex Transport specification

Field.Name: IexTp Message Block Length
Field.Description: Length of the IexTp message block, see the Iex Transport specification

Field.Name: IexTp Message Length
Field.Description: Length of the wrapped Deep message in bytes not including this field

Field.Name: IexTp Message Type
Field.Description: Code identifying the wrapped Deep message type

Field.Name: IexTp Message Data
Field.Description: One complete Iex Deep formatted message, may be any Deep message type, see the Iex Transport specification

Message.Name: Snapshot End Message
Message.Description: Final message of a Snapshot Response, carries the sequence number at which the snapshot was created

Field.Name: Snapshot Sequence Number
Field.Description: Sequence at which the snapshot was created
